Precinct by precinct with Election Day, absentee (stored as mail: mail-in and absentee ballots) and provisional votes. For the state and federal contests it equals the Department's certified Allegheny figures in 27 of 27 contests, whose precinct rows are stored. Write-in lines are stored only for the county's own contests.

The county board of elections' own workbook (Archived Data Sets page), division by division with Election Day, mail and provisional votes, and the ballots for federal offices only counted by congressional district (2ND CD, 3RD CD, 5TH CD). The page does not say whether it is the certified canvass; for the state and federal contests its figures were compared with the Department's certified Philadelphia figures and equal them in 34 of 34 contests, whose division rows are stored. Registration and turnout columns are not read; write-in columns are stored only for the city's own contests.

GetOfficeData: the Department's summary of the certified returns, each district's candidates with their statewide or district votes and the votes cast on Election Day, by mail (mail-in and absentee ballots) and on provisional ballots. The election list marks the election official ('O').
